  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",

  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed before wide excision of the primary melanoma when indicated.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision whenever possible.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow margin of 1–3 mm to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as facial lesions (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genital lesions.",
